decode.method: ffmpeg decode of every frame of the encoded file at 1280x720 RGB, statistics on every 4th pixel; uniform = gray 0.5 to 99.5 percentile range under 2/255

seams.method: Last outgoing and first incoming frames taken by frame index from the full decode of the encoded ep009-full-r1.mp4; difference = mean absolute RGB difference in 0-255 at 1280x720; half-drawn heuristic = incoming frame gray std under 0.6x the std 12 frames later with more than 10/255 change.

flags: planned continuous boundary differs by more than 20/255
planned continuous boundary differs by more than 20/255

audio.method: Program audio decoded from ep009-full.mp4 (48 kHz stereo float); master decoded from the WAV; zero-lag Pearson correlation and RMS difference per channel in 20 evenly spaced 10 s windows and over the full master length.

loudness.note: Recorded only; no normalization applied. Mono master measures about 3 LU lower than its unity stereo upmix under BS.1770 channel summing.

presenter_sync_risk.reason: Fal restorations placed audio 0.39 to 0.53 s late in P01, P03, P05 (presenter INDEX assembler_notes); picture follows each file's own audio.

strips.judged: not judged by agent; reviewer compares mouth-opening onset to word onset (tile label rel ms is frame time minus first-word start)
